next.reason: §1989:A.2.33.3 AR1, as amended in place by X3.23b-1993 (the printed X3.23a-1989 rule read 'If more than one argument-1 is specified, all arguments must be of the same class.'): 'all arguments must be of the same class with the exception that mixing of arguments of alphabetic and alphanumeric classes is allowed.' §2023:15.72.3 AR3: 'All arguments shall be of the same class with the exception that mixing of arguments of alphabetic and alphanumeric classes is allowed.' The amendment added the alphabetic/alphanumeric exception, which the withdrawn record had counted as a 2023 change; with it both texts refuse the same mixed-class ORD-MIN argument lists and accept the same ones. 1989's 'If more than one argument-1 is specified' is implied by 2023's 'All arguments'. Which classes an argument may have at all is a separate 2023 rule (§2023:15.72.3 AR1), not this one.
